messages:
Aisha: Quick pack — compact contribution summaries for self-reviews and manager 1:1s. Sharing three short templates (one-line, three-line, and a micro example) to help folks boil down impact quickly. Please skim and lmk if anything missing.

Aisha: TL;DR: 1) What I shipped, 2) Why it mattered to users/business, 3) Measurable outcome or next step. Keep to 30s read.

Tom: love this. can we add an explicit line for cross-team blockers/resolved? helps managers see collaboration signal.

Aisha: yep good call — addable as a 4th micro-bullet. will add optional "cross-team impact" tag.

Priya: these are great. could we provide an example for ICs vs managers? managers might want a concise coaching note.

Aisha: done — added a manager micro-template below.

Aisha: Templates: copy/paste into self-review or 1:1 notes.

Aisha: ````
One-line (30s):
- Shipped incremental search cache + prefix-indexing; reduced median search latency by 40% for 95th percentile queries.

Three-line (short):
- What: Implemented search cache and prefix-indexing on API layer.
- Why it mattered: Cut tail latency and reduced timeouts for large result sets, improving UX for power users.
- Outcome/next: 40% median p95 latency drop, rollout to all regions next week; follow-up: monitor error % over next 2 sprints.

Manager micro-note (for 1:1):
- Quick praise: Led cross-functional rollout, coordinated infra and frontend teams.
- Coaching: Consider delegating monitoring dashboard ownership to a junior engineer for growth.
- Ask: Can we unblock partner team on throttle config?
````

Tom: tiny wording nit: in the 3-line example, maybe change "40% median p95 latency drop" to "p95 latency reduced ~40%" — reads clearer. :+1:

Aisha: updated. thanks.

Priya: love the manager micro-note. can we add a short sentence template for peer feedback to paste in threads? e.g., "@name did X and it helped Y"

Aisha: good idea. added: 

Aisha: Peer feedback micro-line: `@alex shipped the cache work which cut query time and made our dashboards reliable for demos — thanks!`

People Ops Bot: Reminder: self-reviews due this Friday 11:59pm PT. Use the compact templates to keep drafts concise. Link: https://intranet.redwood.ai/self-review-guide :calendar: 

Tom: volunteered to convert these into a one-pager doc and a notch in the self-review form. I'll take it.

Priya: thanks Tom — if you want, I can add a few examples from last cycle for context.

Tom: please do. will ping later for a quick review.

Aisha: awesome — thanks everyone. I'll post the final snippet in #general after Tom uploads the doc. :party_parrot:
